title: Just What I Needed
body:
The app is magnificent.The good thing is when you choose your habits, and sometimes you get bored and like “not this again” and you do it it feels so good. An example is reading, if you open the book and start to read (if your interested to the book of course) than you will love it. I love this app it motivates you.
    Not just reading many more like exercise, eating healthy, eating fruits and veggies etc.

   I hope this apps becomes even better. And a good job for everyone who helped and work for this app

title: Solid in its looks and has the right kind of features
body: Scheduling settings are just the right kind of flexible (incl. very useful optional Morning, Afternoon, Evening choices). Interface is intuitive to use, and looks good. Today screen helpfully shows extra info under each item regarding how many you have left of each this week (if on an "X times per week" schedule) while being uncluttered. Very good implementation of being able to check off previous days’ tasks (i.e. no locks preventing you from accessing and editing previous days). The app succeeds in being a motivator, and I believe it is the best of its kind that I have seen and tried so far.
